selection.selection_rule: At fixed simulated departure point (39.2N, 122.2E), group all 3-hour WAVERYS timestamps by month; sort each month by deterministic wave-excitation stratum score Hs/Tp^2; select 8 evenly spaced cases from each lower/middle/upper tercile (24 per month x 5 months = 120).
